services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: Our tuna fishing charters are designed to provide you with an unforgettable deep-sea fishing experience. We target albacore tuna, which are known for their speed and strength, giving anglers an adrenaline-pumping battle. Our experienced captains and crew have extensive knowledge of the local waters, ensuring you have the best chance of a successful catch. Whether you’re looking to reel in your first tuna or add to your collection, our charters offer the perfect opportunity. Our tuna fishing season runs from July through October, when the warm waters bring these magnificent fish closer to shore. services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Our whale watching tours are perfect for families, nature enthusiasts, and anyone looking to experience the awe-inspiring beauty of these gentle giants. Our experienced crew will guide you through the waters, providing insights into the behavior and habits of whales, ensuring a truly educational and memorable experience. At Newport Tradewinds, safety and comfort are our top priorities. Our vessels are equipped to provide a smooth ride, allowing you to relax and enjoy the breathtaking views of the Oregon coastline and the majestic whales that inhabit these waters.
